default.description: The main webview subscribes to the four shell events through Tauri's event registry (core:event:default), which is what plugin:event|listen needs, and opens links with the opener plugin: allow-open-url grants the command and allow-default-urls is the scope without which every http(s)/mailto/tel URL is still refused. back_gesture_result is NOT listed: an app command registered via invoke_handler is always reachable and has no ACL entry to grant -- naming one that does not exist fails the build, which is how this file was once broken. The back-gesture plugin has no JS-facing commands and so nothing to grant. platforms is explicit: everything here exists on all five, so the desktop dev build must not fail on it; a mobile-only grant belongs in its own capability scoped to its platform.
